events.title: AI makes fake invoices look real: can someone email as you? | Raileon AI Lab
events.description:
Scammers don’t need to break into your email to send a fake invoice or “new wiring instructions” in your name. If your domain isn’t set up to block fakes, anyone can put your exact email address on a fake message, and many inboxes will deliver it. AI tools make fake emails and invoices look more convincing, so an email that looks right is no longer proof that it’s real.
In October 2026, Raileon checked the public email settings of 749 South Florida law firms and real estate offices. About 4 in 5 haven’t told inboxes to block fake email in their name.

Find your way back to the present moment through movement, breath, and mindfulness. Set within the living sanctuary of the Garden.

events.venue: City of Miami Beach Arts Calendar
events.description:
Discover the story of legendary designer Salvatore Ferragamo in Salvatore: Shoemaker of Dreams (2020), Luca Guadagnino’s documentary tracing his journey from southern Italy to Hollywood and Florence. Through archival footage and interviews, the film explores the craftsmanship, experimentation, and imagination that made Ferragamo “shoemaker to the stars.” Come early to see the exhibition Foot Notes: Shoes, Symbolism, and Society, featuring Ferragamo’s iconic 1938 Rainbow sandal, before settling in for a cinematic look at the life and legacy behind the design.
